observations.note: six persistent flags appeared in the 20:35:45->20:37:20 window; at least one is this Korok, the others look like first-time UI/save flags (they stay 1 in every later save)
single new flag: koroks do have a per-object flag; the earlier 'no flag' was a diff-window attribution error

ambiguous: the two saves the player named (8:00 -> 8:05) show no new flag; thirteen flags appeared in the previous window 21:17:05 -> 21:18:33, so the chest may have been opened before the 21:18 save (or those were first-time flags). needs a clean re-test.

findings.eventModel: an in-game event sets a group of opaque 32-bit flag keys; no flag name or object id is needed to detect it
findings.perObject: chest-1 {0x1BED068D,0x1F23D973,0xAD3CBF08} and chest-2 {0xDBEA8E06,0xF9525C48} do not overlap
findings.korok: korok #2 sets exactly one persistent flag 0xB33C6725; the first korok window also contained five first-time UI/save flags that persist, which is why it looked flagless
findings.counter0x449B3BA6: values run 16..23 then wrap to 0..4 across saves, so it is not an event counter; most likely an in-game hour (0-23) or another time-like field. Earlier 'increments on event X' observations were time passing.
findings.hashMapping: CRC32/CRC32C/Murmur3-32/FNV-1a over 3373 GameDataList names and 666 wiki source_ids do not produce the observed keys
findings.position: the save carries the player position (tag 0xC884818D), so no memory read is needed for the binding step
findings.chestGroups: chest-1 {0x1BED068D,0x1F23D973,0xAD3CBF08} (3), chest-2 {0xDBEA8E06,0xF9525C48} (2), chest-3 {0x1932FAB1,0x2D048130,0x736B8EC3,0x8F4849A7} (4): all disjoint, group size varies; bind the whole group.
findings.firstTimeFlags: some flags are first-time UI/save flags (set once, stay 1): a group can contain more keys than the object needs; bind groups but keep an 'unexpected group size' review state

timeOfDay.note: the player reported the in-game clock at both saves; hour 0x449B3BA6 and minute 0x2106FA19 match exactly
